description: A port of the Service, keyed by name.

nodePort.description: Port opened on every node. Only for `type: NodePort`.

targetSelector.description: Name of the container port or workload the port points to. Defaults to the primary workload.

targetPort.description: Port on the pod the traffic is sent to, a number only. Defaults to `port`.

protocol.description: Protocol of the port: `tcp`, `udp`, `sctp`, `http` or `https`. `http` and `https` are used as `TCP` where needed. Also used by container ports and probes.

appProtocol.description: Application protocol of the port, eg `https`. Also used by the `Endpoints` and `EndpointSlice` objects of `type: ExternalIP`.

hostPort.description: Port opened on the node by the container. Avoid this unless the app cannot work without it.

primary.description: Make this the primary port of the Service. Only 1 port can be primary.
